name: W12 Outcome, disposition & feedback (DRAFT pending GATE-TEST-W12)

parameters.content:
W12 Outcome, disposition & feedback (two-sided), 4.6 W12 row + 4.12a + Schedule C/D + 0.1 broker feedback rule. DRAFT pending GATE-TEST-W12.
Logic: automation/lib/w12.mjs (pure), loaded by every Code node through the lv-automation loader (index.cjs).
Broker side: broker_outcome_check at slot end + 15 min (Attended / No-show / Rescheduled), ONE nudge 3 h later. Attended -> one-tap disposition list at once (session; the tap opened his window; 4.12a codes; template broker_disposition only out of window) -> W29 takes the reply, asks quality 1-5 and the optional voice note. Unmarked at 24 h -> attended + auto_marked + unconfirmed (flagged in the console; two within 30 days -> Jonathan calls the broker). W11 keeps its 24-h backstop (ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING on both sides).
Lead side: reach_check at slot end + 30 min. Broker "No-show" counts only after the lead stays silent for the 2-h reach window; lead "No, not yet" waits for the broker (R6-03): still unmarked at broker_nudge_at = BROKER no-show (Schedule D: lines.mjs BROKER_NO_SHOW_APOLOGY, W10 rebook at our cost, KG alerted, never a replacement); a broker Attended / Rescheduled / No-show against it = conflict for KG in the console, nothing to the lead; Unreachable/wrong number = normal W13 path. Sides disagree -> console queue, nothing guessed.
Writes: outcomes (one row per booking, first writer wins), appointments.status, leads.stage, lead_activities timeline (w12:mark / w12:reach rows, last tap wins per CONTRACTS). Calls: W29 outcome_recorded (every outcome; pulse/facts, quality index), CAPI Send Attended (I-51b: held until the lead answered or her 2.5-h window closed; held on a lead "No" until KG decides via op kg_decision; never on Unreachable; w12:capi_hold / w12:capi_release rows), W13 no_show (missed_you + 48-h clock), W10 rebook, CAPI Send Qualified + GoodFit (tick sweep of leads.qualified_at on a tier A/B band and good-fit outcomes from W29 or the portal; capi_log dedupe; GoodFit offline only, value = rating). Portal marks (outcomes written by the broker portal, marked_via portal) are read on the tick and resolved with the same two-sided rules; they and the W11 auto-attended row run the follow-ups only after claiming w12:outcome:{bk}, the key the sweep insert writes, so each booking gets them once. Voice note (op voice_note): only the WhatsApp media reference is stored (outcomes.voice_note_url = whatsapp-media:{id}).
Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=lv-automation. Env: DRY_RUN_SENDS, META_GRAPH_VERSION, PHONE_NUMBER_ID, META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN, TEST_HOOKS_ENABLED.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { op: 'tick' } };

nodes.name: Record broker mark (w12:mark, last tap wins)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT a.client_id, a.brand_id, a.broker_id, 'W12', 'broker', 'broker_outcome_mark', jsonb_build_object('mark', $2::text, 'booking_id', a.id::text), now(), 'w12:mark:' || a.id::text
  FROM public.appointments a WHERE a.id = $1::uuid

nodes.name: Record reach answer (w12:reach, last tap wins)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT a.client_id, a.brand_id, a.broker_id, 'W12', 'lead', 'reach_check', jsonb_build_object('answer', $2::text, 'booking_id', a.id::text), now(), 'w12:reach:' || a.id::text
  FROM public.appointments a WHERE a.id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at
RETURNING lead_id, payload->>'answer' AS answer;

SELECT a.id AS booking_id, a.client_id AS lead_id, a.brand_id, a.broker_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at AS slot_end, a.status,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.language, l.opted_out_at,
       b.adviser_name, b.contact_person, b.adviser_whatsapp, b.whatsapp_number,
       (SELECT m.payload->>'mark' FROM public.lead_activities m WHERE m.idempotency_key = 'w12:mark:' || a.id::text) AS broker_mark,
       (SELECT r.payload->>'answer' FROM public.lead_activities r WHERE r.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach:' || a.id::text) AS reach,
       (SELECT r.occurred_at FROM public.lead_activities r WHERE r.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach:' || a.id::text) AS reach_at,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities s WHERE s.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach_thanks:' || a.id::text) AS sent_reach_thanks,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities s WHERE s.idempotency_key = 'w12:outcome_check:' || a.id::text) AS sent_outcome_check,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities s WHERE s.idempotency_key = 'w12:broker_nudge:' || a.id::text) AS sent_broker_nudge,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities s WHERE s.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach_check:' || a.id::text) AS sent_reach_check,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.outcomes o WHERE o.booking_id = a.id) AS outcome_exists
  FROM public.appointments a
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
   AND ($3::uuid IS NOT NULL OR a.ends_at <= $1::timestamptz)
   AND a.ends_at > $1::timestamptz - interval '48 hours'
   AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR a.id = $3::uuid)
   AND (NOT $2::boolean OR l.is_synthetic)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.outcomes o WHERE o.booking_id = a.id)
 ORDER BY a.ends_at
 LIMIT 200;

parameters.query:
WITH o AS (
  INSERT INTO public.outcomes (booking_id, lead_id, broker_id, brand_id, outcome, lead_reach_check, marked_via, marked_at, auto_marked, unconfirmed, dispute_status)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9::boolean, $10::boolean, $11)
  ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, booking_id, lead_id, broker_id),
ap AS (UPDATE public.appointments SET status = $12, updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
st AS (UPDATE public.leads SET stage = COALESCE($13, stage), conv_state = CASE WHEN $14::text IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(conv_state->>'state', '') NOT IN ('opted_out', 'handoff') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments nb JOIN public.appointments ob ON ob.id = (SELECT o.booking_id FROM o WHERE o.lead_id = leads.id LIMIT 1) WHERE nb.client_id = leads.id AND nb.id <> ob.id AND nb.status IN ('pending_verification','booked','confirmed') AND nb.appointment_date > ob.appointment_date) THEN COALESCE(conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', $14::text) ELSE conv_state END, updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
tl AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  SELECT o.lead_id, $4::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W12', 'system', 'outcome_recorded', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', o.booking_id::text, 'outcome', $5::text, 'auto_marked', $9::boolean, 'unconfirmed', $10::boolean, 'reach', $6::text), now(), 'w12:outcome:' || o.booking_id::text
    FROM o
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id),
fl AS (
  INSERT INTO public.escalations (brand_id, kind, severity, ref_table, ref_id, lead_id, broker_id, raised_at, note)
  SELECT $4::uuid, 'outcome_unmarked', 'normal', 'outcomes', o.id::text, o.lead_id, $3::uuid, now(), 'esc_kind=outcome_unmarked; auto-marked attended at 24 h, unconfirmed'
    FROM o WHERE $10::boolean
  RETURNING id),
two AS (
  INSERT INTO public.escalations (brand_id, kind, severity, ref_table, ref_id, broker_id, raised_at, note)
  SELECT $4::uuid, 'outcome_unmarked', 'urgent', 'outcomes', o.id::text, $3::uuid, now(), 'esc_kind=two_unconfirmed; Jonathan calls the broker (4.12a)'
    FROM o
   -- two unconfirmed outcomes for this broker within 30 days (there are no cycles: capacity is the CRM lead order)
   WHERE $10::boolean AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.outcomes x WHERE x.broker_id = o.broker_id AND x.unconfirmed AND x.marked_at > now() - interval '30 days') + 1 >= 2
  RETURNING id)
SELECT o.id AS outcome_id FROM o;

nodes.name: Claim W12 follow-ups (w12:outcome, once per booking)

parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W12', 'system', 'outcome_recorded', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', $4::text, 'outcome', $5::text, 'marked_via', $6::text, 'resolved_as', $7::text, 'reach', $8::text), now(), 'w12:outcome:' || $4::text)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id),
d AS (UPDATE public.outcomes SET dispute_status = 'open', updated_at = now()
       WHERE booking_id = $4::uuid AND $9::boolean AND dispute_status = 'none' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c) RETURNING id),
ap AS (UPDATE public.appointments SET status = $10, updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $4::uuid AND $10 IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c) RETURNING id),
st AS (UPDATE public.leads SET stage = COALESCE($11, stage), conv_state = CASE WHEN $12::text IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(conv_state->>'state', '') NOT IN ('opted_out', 'handoff') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments nb JOIN public.appointments ob ON ob.id = $4::uuid WHERE nb.client_id = leads.id AND nb.id <> ob.id AND nb.status IN ('pending_verification','booked','confirmed') AND nb.appointment_date > ob.appointment_date) THEN COALESCE(conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', $12::text) ELSE conv_state END, updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1::uuid AND ($11 IS NOT NULL OR $12 IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c) RETURNING id)
SELECT c.id FROM c;

INSERT INTO public.escalations (brand_id, kind, severity, ref_table, ref_id, lead_id, broker_id, raised_at, note)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2, $3, 'appointments', $4, $5::uuid, $6::uuid, now(), $7
 -- one open row per booking + kind + esc_kind (note prefix): a broker_no_whatsapp 'other' must not mask a broker_no_show 'other'
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.escalations e WHERE e.ref_table = 'appointments' AND e.ref_id = $4 AND e.kind = $2 AND e.resolved_at IS NULL
                     AND split_part(COALESCE(e.note, ''), ';', 1) = split_part(COALESCE($7, ''), ';', 1));

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id AS booking_id, h.lead_id, h.brand_id, h.broker_id, a.ends_at AS slot_end,
       h.payload->>'event_id' AS event_id, o.outcome AS outcome_outcome, o.disposition_code,
       (SELECT r.payload->>'answer' FROM public.lead_activities r WHERE r.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach:' || a.id::text) AS reach,
       (SELECT k.payload->>'decision' FROM public.lead_activities k WHERE k.idempotency_key = 'w12:kg_decision:' || a.id::text) AS kg_decision,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, b.adviser_name, b.contact_person
  FROM public.lead_activities h
  JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id::text = h.payload->>'booking_id'
  JOIN public.outcomes o ON o.booking_id = a.id
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = h.lead_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
 WHERE h.activity_type = 'capi_attended_held'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities x WHERE x.idempotency_key = 'w12:capi_release:' || a.id::text)
   AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR a.id = $3::uuid)
   AND (NOT $2::boolean OR l.is_synthetic)
 ORDER BY a.ends_at
 LIMIT 200;

parameters.query:
WITH k AS (SELECT 1 AS ok FROM public.lead_activities WHERE idempotency_key = 'w12:kg_decision:' || $1::text AND payload->>'decision' = 'not_attended'),
o AS (
  UPDATE public.outcomes SET outcome = 'no_show', dispute_status = 'upheld', unconfirmed = false, marked_via = 'console', marked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   WHERE booking_id = $1::uuid AND outcome = 'attended' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM k)
  RETURNING id, booking_id, lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, marked_at),
ap AS (UPDATE public.appointments SET status = 'no_show', updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
st AS (UPDATE public.leads SET stage = 'no_show', conv_state = CASE WHEN COALESCE(conv_state->>'state', '') NOT IN ('opted_out', 'handoff') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments nb JOIN public.appointments ob ON ob.id = (SELECT o.booking_id FROM o WHERE o.lead_id = leads.id LIMIT 1) WHERE nb.client_id = leads.id AND nb.id <> ob.id AND nb.status IN ('pending_verification','booked','confirmed') AND nb.appointment_date > ob.appointment_date) THEN COALESCE(conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('state', 'no_show') ELSE conv_state END, updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
tl AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  SELECT o.lead_id, o.brand_id, o.broker_id, 'W12', 'system', 'outcome_kg_not_attended', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', o.booking_id::text, 'from', 'attended', 'to', 'no_show', 'nh', 'NH-62', 'decided_by', $2::text), now(), 'w12:kg_not_attended:' || o.booking_id::text
    FROM o
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT o.id AS outcome_id, o.booking_id, o.lead_id, o.marked_at AS confirmed_at FROM o;

  SELECT 'Qualified'::text AS event_name, l.id AS lead_id, l.brand_id, l.ctwa_clid, l.qualified_at AS event_time, NULL::int AS quality_score
    FROM public.leads l
   WHERE l.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND l.qualified_at IS NOT NULL
     AND l.qualified_at > $1::timestamptz - interval '156 hours' AND l.qualified_at <= $1::timestamptz
     -- tier A/B on the budget, or (/start/ v4, Jono 19 Oct 2026 FINAL: no budget asked) the page's rule, the same as
     -- lib/w39.mjs isQualifiedV4: income R15k+ AND age 35-50; tier C (lt750) never qualifies either way
     AND (l.budget_band IN ('750_1250', '750_1499', '1250plus', '1250_1499', '1500_plus') OR (l.budget_band IS NULL AND l.age_band IN ('35_44', '45_50') AND l.income_band IN ('15k_30k', '30k_50k', '50k_80k', '80kplus', '20k_40k', '40k_60k', '60k_100k', '100kplus')))
     AND l.opted_out_at IS NULL AND coalesce(l.stage, 'new') NOT IN ('disqualified', 'opted_out')
     AND (l.ctwa_clid IS NOT NULL OR l.consent_ads_at IS NOT NULL)
     AND (NOT $2::boolean OR l.is_synthetic)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.capi_log g WHERE g.event_id = 'evt_' || l.id::text || '_qualified' AND g.event_name = 'Qualified')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'GoodFit'::text, o.lead_id, o.brand_id, NULL::text, o.marked_at, o.quality_score::int
    FROM public.outcomes o
    JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = o.lead_id
   WHERE o.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND o.outcome = 'attended' AND o.dispute_status <> 'open'
     AND o.disposition_code::text IN ('fit_proceeding', 'fit_followup')
     AND o.marked_at > $1::timestamptz - interval '156 hours' AND o.marked_at <= $1::timestamptz
     AND l.opted_out_at IS NULL AND l.consent_ads_at IS NOT NULL
     AND (NOT $2::boolean OR l.is_synthetic)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.capi_log g WHERE g.event_id = 'evt_' || o.lead_id::text || '_goodfit' AND g.event_name = 'GoodFit')
) q
 ORDER BY q.event_time
 LIMIT 200;

SELECT o.id AS outcome_id, o.outcome, o.disposition_code,
       a.id AS booking_id, a.client_id AS lead_id, a.brand_id, a.broker_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at AS slot_end,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.language, l.opted_out_at,
       b.adviser_name, b.contact_person, b.adviser_whatsapp, b.whatsapp_number,
       (SELECT r.payload->>'answer' FROM public.lead_activities r WHERE r.idempotency_key = 'w12:reach:' || a.id::text) AS reach
  FROM public.outcomes o
  JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id = o.booking_id
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
 WHERE o.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND o.marked_via = 'portal' AND o.dispute_status = 'none'
   AND o.outcome IN ('attended', 'no_show', 'rescheduled')
   AND a.ends_at <= $1::timestamptz AND a.ends_at > $1::timestamptz - interval '48 hours'
   AND (NOT $2::boolean OR l.is_synthetic)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities c WHERE c.idempotency_key = 'w12:outcome:' || a.id::text)
 ORDER BY a.ends_at
 LIMIT 200;
